steps.text: Click "Add" to open the dialog for creating a new sharing operation. By default, every new operation is created in private mode: it is not yet visible in the public directory.
steps.title: Add an operation

steps.text: Type a name for the new operation. This name will appear in the management list and in the public directory once the operation is made public.
steps.title: Name the operation

steps.text: Select the "Local" type for sharing within a single building. This type, like CER and CEC, can be made public to appear in the energy community directory.
steps.title: Select the Local type

steps.text: Type the first letters of a municipality the operation covers.
steps.title: Search a municipality

steps.text: Pick the municipality from the suggestions.
steps.title: Pick the municipality

steps.text: Submit the form to create the sharing operation.
steps.title: Create the operation

steps.text: The new "E2E Energy Sharing" appears in the list. It is currently private: visible only to community managers and not yet shown in the public directory.
steps.title: Operation created

steps.text: Click the new operation's row to open its detail page and access the visibility settings.
steps.title: Open the detail

steps.text: The grey "PRIVATE" button in the header shows that this operation is not yet visible in the public directory. Citizens searching for a sharing operation in their municipality cannot find it as long as it remains private.
steps.title: Private by default

steps.text: Click the visibility button to switch the operation to public mode. The change is saved immediately: the operation becomes visible in the energy community directory for all citizens.
steps.title: Make the operation public

steps.text: The button turns green and shows "PUBLIC". Any citizen can now find this operation in the energy community directory, filter by municipality, and contact the community to request participation.
steps.title: Operation is now public
